description: This file defines the KinesisClient class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis service, including method annotations for various operations such as creating streams, deleting streams, getting records, and managing stream configurations.

classes.name: KinesisClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Kinesis service, extending AwsClient to provide specific methods related to Kinesis streams.

methods.name: addTagsToStream
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified Kinesis stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: deleteStream
methods.description: Deletes the specified Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: describeStream
methods.description: Provides details about the specified Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Reads data records from a Kinesis stream.

methods.name: listStreams
methods.description: Lists all existing Kinesis data streams.

methods.name: updateShardCount
methods.description: Updates the shard count of a specified stream.
